summary: Intelligent Earth is a UKRI Centre for Doctoral Training at the University of Oxford for DPhil (PhD) research in artificial intelligence for the environment. Admissions for 2027 entry are open, with full-time and part-time study options. The final deadline for 2027-28 entry is 12:00 midday UK time on 6 January 2027, and the expected start date is 27 September 2027.
highlights: Submit at least two weeks before the deadline to be considered for January-round scholarships.
Interviews expected in the second half of February.
Application status not yet confirmed: verify the dates and requirements on the official Oxford admissions page before applying.
